recommendation: Keep the audit as-is. Reopen source work only if FM and X12 approve open publication of specific X12 837 mapping content or identify an appropriate external/IG source location.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification Claim issue asking for X12 837 mapping consideration; the final resolution said HL7 would attempt to engage X12 and the outcome would determine whether such a mapping was done.
initial_application: No Jira-tagged source commit for FHIR-7705 was found. The current active Claim narrative includes general FM mapping guidance for UB04/CMS1500 plus an IP-restriction caveat for other mappings, while authoritative Claim XML/TXT source contains no X12 or 837 mapping content.
additional_context: FHIR-21648 later requested explicit Claim to X12 EDI 837 mappings and was Resolved - No Change/Not Persuasive because X12 proprietary information cannot be included without express X12 consent. Zulip financial discussion also treated X12/FHIR mappings as licensed X12-channel material.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit and made no source edit. Adding X12 837 mapping text to core would conflict with the later no-change/IP decision, and the current general mapping/IP caveat is the safe current-spec position.
